source: lane lock-wrapper-io: lock_discipline_check now reports a funcall of a non-literal special variable under a lock
title: Two developer fault hooks (*fnn-record-barrier-fault-observer*, io.lisp:8060; *fnn-identity-reservation-callback*, io.lisp:9105) are funcalled under the owner mutex O with a function the checker cannot see
notes: Both defvars are NIL in normal operation and are dynamically bound by developer and test cuts (comments at io.lisp:1981-1984), so production never runs a hook; but a bound hook runs under O and the checker cannot classify what it does. Decision owed: either the hooks are retired from the served image (compiled out of the production path, then the keys vanish), or each bound hook is a named defun the seam resolves (#'NAME init with a classifiable body), or the contract records them as developer-only cuts with a bound. Not the checker's to decide; no exception row was added.
